Players Committee card image of [[Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. if a Rebel just moved from here, your Imperials present may follow that character (using landspeed). While at a battleground site, functions as a general and game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/grandadmiralthrawn_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da 25528d7] (10 August 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
